integrity: The 62 required gapped-subsequence counts are checked exactly by two independent finite procedures: a prefix recurrence and direct enumeration of all nonadjacent index tuples. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result is only an upper bound G(5)<=50; it does not prove minimality or improve the lower bound. The construction is specific to the displayed published G(4) pair.
title: A 50-bit upper bound for the fifth gapped-deck threshold
